West's collection of moral essays on race relations in America was on the "New York Times" best-seller lists for many weeks. The story also makes reference to Asimov's psychohistory. "The Red Queen's Race" was first published in the January 1949 issue of "Astounding Science Fiction" and reprinted in the 1972 collection "The Early Asimov".
